_: THE CROSS-ZONE ROUTES: each a chain of pieces - a leg (one zone's run, from where the last piece ended), a ride (a transports.json ride, by its path id), or a gap (a link we don't have: the route stops there and says why). A leg's from / to are harness goal objects; {"ride": p, "end": "a"|"b"} is that ride's end, read from transports.json. py/cross.py writes one spec per zone from these and stitches the runs.

routes.name: Valley of Trials → Cairne Bloodhoof (Thunder Bluff)

pieces.name: the Valley of Trials → the Southfury bridge
the Southfury bridge → the Mulgore road
the Mulgore road → Cairne (High Rise, by the lifts)

pieces.gap: the walk inside Stormwind to the Deeprun Tram and the tram itself: Stormwind has no spec (its walls are its WMOs, not on the lattice), and the tram runs in an instance of its own - not among transports.json's rides (CityExits has only its Stormwind entrance, learned on the device). No walk joins Elwynn to Dun Morogh through the zones we have: the Wetlands would need Menethil's boat, not a road.

pieces.name: the Ironforge gate → the South Gate tunnels
the Tirisfal road → Shadowfang Keep's entrance

routes.name: the Orgrimmar gate → the Undercity (Ruins of Lordaeron), by zeppelin

pieces.name: the Orgrimmar gate → the zeppelin tower
the zeppelin tower → the Undercity entrance

pieces.gap: the walk inside Darnassus and its portal down to Rut'theran: the client holds the portal's trigger (AreaTrigger.db2), but where it sends the player is server-only - a manual link nobody has measured. The route resumes at Rut'theran Village.
